purpose: Read-only estate-wide projection of Shine Defence certification, deployment observation, coverage, review progress, intake readiness and exact next action.
rules: The Command Centre joins existing authoritative/read-only projections and does not reimplement certification or deployment-status logic.
Every canonically reviewed app appears exactly once in app-id order.
Certification state and next action come from Operations Controller.
Observed deployment state and identities come from Operations Controller deployment data.
Pre-candidate review progress is derived only from the current intake-planner identity plus any durable human diff review bound to that exact identity.
Candidate intake readiness comes from candidate-intake-readiness-v1.
Missing data is reported explicitly as none, unobserved or not_started rather than inferred.
The report is read-only and never invokes any recommended helper.
Each reviewed-app row includes staleness visibility for deployment observation, human review, pending candidate and certification completion.
Unknown and not_applicable age states remain distinct and are never converted into stale.
Age bands are operational visibility only and do not change next-action selection or attention priority.
Human review progress exposes lastActivityAt only from explicit Human Diff Review workspace activity.
nonClaims: The Command Centre is not certification authority.
A next action shown in the report has not been executed.
Review progress is not checklist approval.
Coverage does not imply a protected deployment.
Age or staleness bands are not security risk scores.
